summary: Cross-border tensions escalated across multiple theaters including Lebanon, Gaza, Iraq, and the Gulf, with artillery fire, drone activity, and militant infiltration attempts reported. Iranian domestic politics saw leadership disputes and media controversies, while U.S. and Israeli defense postures remained heightened amid ongoing regional instability.
key_points: Artillery shelling reported in southern Lebanon targeting Ali al-Tahir and Mansouri areas, with casualties claimed by local media (Source: @SharghDaily/176963).
Israeli airstrikes hit Dahhah Kfarman in Nabatieh, injuring at least two Lebanese civilians (Source: @SharghDaily/176963).
Militant infiltration attempt thwarted in Kibbutz Ofirim, Binyamin region; suspect arrested after exchange of fire (Source: @idf_telegram/24854).
Iraqi security forces seized fixed-wing drones linked to IRGC-backed Islamic Resistance in Iraq, intended for external attacks (Source: @shin_persian/8910).
Saudi industrial gas facility in Jubail targeted by drone attack, flames visible (Source: @naya_foriraq/87326).
Heavy weapons malfunction exposed reused Shahed-107 drone previously found in Wasit, Iraq (Source: @naya_foriraq/87323).
U.S. Pentagon urged accelerated weapons production due to ammunition shortages amid Iran conflict (Source: @lelotsenzura/94106).

sections.executive_summary: Cross-border tensions escalated across Lebanon, Gaza, Iraq, and the Gulf with artillery fire, drone activity, and infiltration attempts reported. Iranian domestic politics saw leadership disputes and media controversies, while U.S. and Israeli defense postures remained heightened amid ongoing regional instability.

points: A video clip allegedly showing Ayatollah Khamenei was published, though its authenticity and recording date remain unclear (Source: @kianmeli1/90732).
Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf indirectly confirmed internal disagreements regarding the resignation of Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf from the National Security Council (Source: @mamlekate/104106).
CNN reported growing divisions within the Trump administration over continuing the war with Iran, citing Gen. Dan Caine's concerns (Source: @mamlekate/104102).
Iranian state media aired footage claimed to depict late Supreme Leader Khamenei during recent events (Source: @lelotsenzura/94103).
Political commentator Mehdi Karrubi dismissed historical narratives promoted by state TV, referencing British naval presence in the Persian Gulf during Qajar era (Source: @kianmeli1/90725).
IDF responded to a suspected militant infiltration in Kibbutz Ofirim, Binyamin region, resulting in the arrest of one individual after live-fire engagement (Source: @idf_telegram/24854).
Pentagon requested expedited weapons manufacturing from U.S. defense firms due to critical ammunition shortages linked to the Iran conflict (Source: @lelotsenzura/94106).
Channel 13 reported that Israel informed CENTCOM it does not require U.S. approval or support for potential operations against Iran (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78982).
Gunfire continued unabated in Kiryat Malakhi, injuring 64-year-old Aharon Gever critically; he was hospitalized at Hillel Yaffe Medical Center (Source: @N12chat/221135).
Israeli artillery shelled southern Lebanon near Ali al-Tahir and Mansouri, causing injuries among Lebanese civilians (Source: @SharghDaily/176963).
Clashes erupted between Jewish and Arab residents in Idna, Hebron, with no further details provided (Source: @lelotsenzura/94102).
An explosive-laden motorcycle was discovered near Lionel Messi’s hotel ahead of the 2026 World Cup, prompting FBI investigation (Source: @pkpoi/143551).
A taxi crashed into pedestrians at a crosswalk in Nahariya, killing a woman and seriously injuring her daughter; driver suspected of medical episode (Source: @pkpoi/143554).
Israeli airstrike in Dahhah Kfarman, Nabatieh, wounded two Lebanese citizens (Source: @SharghDaily/176963).
Daily alerts recorded 129 total incidents, including 98 drone sightings concentrated in Kfar Tounet, Ali al-Tahir, Zouta al-Sharqiyah, and al-Nabatieh al-Fawqa (Source: @redlinkleb/35412).
Artillery strikes targeted Ali al-Tahir and Mansouri regions, with additional shelling reported in al-Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Meis al-Jabal (Source: @redlinkleb/35378).
One drone strike hit Meis al-Jabal, marking a 100% success rate in post-detection targeting (Source: @redlinkleb/35397).
Red Alert Lebanon activated a WhatsApp group and bot system for real-time reporting of hostile activity (Source: @redlinkleb/35415).
Israeli airstrike in Dahhah Kfarman, Nabatieh, injured two Lebanese civilians (Source: @SharghDaily/176963).
Two minor explosions occurred near the Syrian-Iraqi border in Deir ez-Zor province (Source: @naya_foriraq/87320).
Iraqi authorities discovered drones capable of carrying attacks, identified as modified Shahed-107 models with fixed wings (Source: @naya_foriraq/87315).
A three-member cell linked to IRGC-backed Islamic Resistance in Iraq was detained in Babil province with advanced UAVs ready for deployment (Source: @shin_persian/8910).
Heavy weapons malfunction revealed reuse of a previously recovered Shahed drone by Saudi channel Al-Hadath (Source: @naya_foriraq/87323).
Unidentified UAV entered Bulgarian airspace from Romania undetected, detonating near Trans-Balkan gas pipeline (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6162).
ADNOC reported an attack on one of its vessels via missile in the Hormuz Strait, with no casualties confirmed (Source: @lelotsenzura/94101).
Gas station in Jubail Industrial City, Saudi Arabia, came under drone attack with visible fires (Source: @naya_foriraq/87326).
Windward data showed Kharg Island’s western terminal inactive for 18 consecutive days, disrupting Iran’s main oil export hub (Source: @mamlekate/104102).
UKMTO issued maritime security warning 108-26 regarding threats in Gulf waters (Source: @shin_persian/8898).

key_developments: Israeli artillery shelled southern Lebanon near Ali al-Tahir and Mansouri, wounding two Lebanese civilians in Dahhah Kfarman (Source: @SharghDaily/176963).
IDF thwarted a militant infiltration in Kibbutz Ofirim, Binyamin region, arresting one suspect after live-fire exchange (Source: @idf_telegram/24854).
Iraqi forces seized IRGC-linked drones in Babil province, preventing planned attacks beyond Iraq’s borders (Source: @shin_persian/8910).
Saudi gas facility in Jubail Industrial City targeted by drone attack, flames erupted at the site (Source: @naya_foriraq/87326).
U.S. Pentagon urged rapid expansion of weapons production citing severe ammunition shortages tied to Iran conflict (Source: @lelotsenzura/94106).
Channel 13 reported Israel told CENTCOM it needs no U.S. backing for potential strikes on Iran (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78982).
CNN cited Gen. Dan Caine warning Trump officials that escalation with Iran risks adverse outcomes (Source: @mamlekate/104102).
sections.threat_assessment: Regional tensions remain high with active combat operations in Lebanon and Gaza, infiltration attempts along Israeli borders, and persistent drone threats in Iraq and the Gulf. Militant cells linked to the IRGC maintain operational capacity despite recent interdictions. Maritime vulnerabilities persist in the Hormuz Strait following confirmed attacks on commercial shipping. Internal political rifts in Iran and the U.S. suggest possible shifts in strategic direction, increasing unpredictability.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese Hezbollah and allied factions have intensified cross-border artillery exchanges with Israeli forces, signaling readiness for broader confrontation. Iraqi security services continue interdicting IRGC-backed drone networks, indicating ongoing efforts to prevent spillover. Gulf Cooperation Council states have heightened maritime patrols following repeated targeting of energy infrastructure. The U.S. Central Command maintains close coordination with regional partners amid rising rhetoric from Tehran.
sections.intelligence_notes: Recent imagery confirms presence of Sayyad-2/3 surface-to-air missile launchers near damaged U.S. MQ-1C drone wreckage, suggesting advanced air defense deployment (Source: @shin_persian/8890). Iranian state television announced dispersal of news broadcasts across seven locations due to defensive measures, implying concern over signal jamming or cyber interference (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78985). Unverified claims circulate regarding reused Shahed-107 drones operated by Saudi-linked channels, highlighting potential supply chain compromises (Source: @naya_foriraq/87323). Bulgarian officials confirmed failure of both national and NATO radar systems to detect low-altitude UAV incursion, raising questions about layered air defense gaps (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6162).
